messages.subject: Issues deploying apps to shinyapps.io:  setAccountInfo and Packages not available in repository or locally
parts:
Hi 

Couple of issues

 a) I'm looking to deploy an update to an existing app https://pssguy.shinyapps.io/worldBank/ but when I use the
publish button in RStudio am getting 

  building: Building package: sparkline
################################## Begin Log ################################## 
Error: You must register an account using setAccountInfo prior to proceeding.

I have recently gone through the setAccountInfo() process and am able to deploy other apps
Have restarted R , rebooted to no avail

Going via console, I also have a problem

> library(shinyapps)
> deployApp("worldBank")
Error in lint(appDir) : No directory at path 'worldBank'
> getwd()
[1] "C:/Users/pssguy/Documents/R/worldBank"




b) For any deployment I am getting new warning messages
e.g.
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In FUN(c("rmarkdown", "shiny", "rgdal", "leaflet", "dplyr", "WDI",  :
  Package 'leaflet' not available in repository or locally
2: In FUN(c("rmarkdown", "shiny", "rgdal", "leaflet", "dplyr", "WDI",  :
  Package 'DT' not available in repository or locally
3: In FUN(c("rmarkdown", "shiny", "rgdal", "leaflet", "dplyr", "WDI",  :
  Package 'sparkline' not available in repository or locally

These packages are on github so am not sure what the problem is here?
